# system.registerTask

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.0</span></div>

Register a Lua Task.

```lua
system.registerTask(params)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `params` | table | yes | see the fields below |

Fields of `params`:

- `key` (string, 7 chars max): task key
- `name` (string or function): task name
- `init` (function, optional): handler called on task init
- `done` (function, optional): handler called on task stop
- `event` (function, optional): handler called at each event
- `wakeup` (function, optional): handler called at each loop
- `read` (function, optional): optional read handler
- `write` (function, optional): optional write handler
- `configure` (function, optional): handler called on task configuration


## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local function taskName()
  return "My task name"
end

local function taskInit()
  print("Task Init ...")
end

local function taskWakeup()
  print("Task Wakeup ...")
end

local function taskEvent(event)
  print("Task Event", event)
end

local function init()
  system.registerTask({key="LuaTask", name=taskName, init=taskInit, wakeup=taskWakeup, event=taskEvent})
end

return {init=init}
```

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 3 times across 3 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    local function init()
      system.registerTask({
        key = "wf2bg",
        name = "Wingflight [Background]",
        init = taskInit,
        wakeup = taskWakeup,
        event = taskEvent,
      })
    end
    ```

=== "Example 3"

    ```lua
    local function registerBackgroundTask()
        if not system.registerTask then
            log:warn("system.registerTask is unavailable")
            return
        end
    
        system.registerTask({
            name = runtime.config.bgTaskName,
            key = runtime.config.bgTaskKey,
            init = backgroundTask.init,
            wakeup = backgroundTask.wakeup,
            event = backgroundTask.event,
            read = backgroundTask.read,
            write = backgroundTask.write
        })
    end
    ```
